tools.name: search
tools.description: Find public FiveM guides using short keywords. All query terms must match. Returns up to ten citable results; use fetch to read a guide.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve a public guide's Markdown/MDX text and citation URL using an exact ID returned by search. Interactive component data is available on the linked website.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Read blip sprites, control IDs/default bindings, or ped names/hashes from the same imported data used on the website. Returns at most 20 rows with source, retrieval date, context and limits. Numeric IDs/hashes match exact values. No code execution or runtime compatibility guarantee.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
